description: This Java class, PdfSurveyServices, provides services for handling PDF-based surveys within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for building surveys from PDFs, processing survey responses, extracting and setting Acrobat form fields, generating PDFs from survey responses, and managing survey questions and answers. The code heavily interacts with PDF manipulation libraries, OFBiz entity engine, and services to facilitate PDF-based survey workflows.

classes.name: PdfSurveyServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for handling PDF surveys, including creation, response processing, and PDF form manipulation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildSurveyFromPdf
methods.description: Creates a new survey in the system from the data extracted from a PDF form, including form fields and annotations.

methods.name: buildSurveyResponseFromPdf
methods.description: Builds and stores a survey response in the system based on data extracted from a filled PDF form.

methods.name: getAcroFieldsFromPdf
methods.description: Extracts all form field names and their values from a PDF file.

methods.name: setAcroFields
methods.description: Populates a PDF's form fields with given data and returns the modified PDF as a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: buildPdfFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Generates a PDF document summarizing a survey response, including all answered questions.

methods.name: buildSurveyQuestionsAndAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves questions and answers associated with a survey response, pairing each question with its answer.

methods.name: setAcroFieldsFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Populates PDF form fields with answers from a survey response and optionally writes the result to a file.

methods.name: getInputByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the input PDF as a ByteBuffer either from a file or from content stored in the system.
